Laura / Grace — dug into this morning. Notes below: 

1) Root cause: credits from NovaPartner with missing CustomerTaxRegion value were defaulting into AR_SUSPENSE during our auto-post transformation (rule change deployed 2027-04-12). For cross-border partner credits we normally apply reverse-charge (EU) tagging, but the missing region triggered our fallback to UK VAT.

2) Impact on revenue mapping: These are billing timing credits (not revenue reversals) but because they landed in AR_SUSPENSE our AR aging reports and unapplied-payment allocation logic didn't clear them against open invoices. If we move the entries to AR_CUSTOMER and reassign the VAT tag to EU-RC, revenue recognition mapping won't change (no revenue reversal entries expected), but the unapplied balance will clear and customer collections can proceed.

3) Proposed fix (attached): create a corrective journal JNL-2027-04CN that moves the affected lines from AR_SUSPENSE -> AR_CUSTOMER and updates VAT tag. Steps:
   - Run journal in 'staged' mode (no GL post) and validate with test balances
   - If OK, post cutover after EOD accounting run on 2027-05-04

4) Notes for Tax: changing VAT tag will require NovaPartner to re-evaluate their filing if they already included the original tag; suggest we coordinate with their tax contact and our tax team (cc'd).

Attaching a draft journal sheet with proposed debits/credits and a small sample mapping extract.

Marcus Lin
Director, Revenue Accounting | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: proposed_journal_2027-04CN.xlsx (XLSX)]
